sentence: The teacher to who I gave my essay has lost it.
ruleVi: Văn phong trang trọng: giới từ + whom khi chỉ người.

sentence: The documents to that you referred are attached.
ruleVi: Sau giới từ không dùng that; chỉ vật dùng giới từ + which.

sentence: I regret informing you that your application has been unsuccessful.
ruleVi: Regret to inform = lấy làm tiếc phải thông báo; regret V-ing là hối hận đã làm.

sentence: We look forward to hear from you.
Please find attaching the report you requested.
ruleVi: Cụm cố định trong thư: Please find attached.

sentence: The company in which I work for is based in Singapore.
ruleVi: Giới từ chỉ đứng một chỗ: which I work for hoặc for which I work.

sentence: It has been deciding that the meeting will be postponed.
ruleVi: Văn phong trang trọng dùng bị động vô nhân xưng: It has been decided that.

sentence: Applicants are required submitting two references.
Should you require further assistance, do not hesitate contacting us.
I am writing for confirming the booking we discussed.
ruleVi: Nêu mục đích viết thư: I am writing to + động từ.
